title: Show the payment date in the invoice list

blockedBy.title: Record the payment date of invoices

description:
Accounting wants to see when an invoice was paid without opening the data file.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `python -m invoicing list` shows the payment date (YYYY-MM-DD) for paid invoices
- [ ] Unpaid invoices show `-` in that column
- [ ] The JSON export includes the payment date as `paid_on` (null when unpaid)
